## Why This Is Asked

This tests practical CTAS configuration skills for multi-tenant governance and external collaboration, a growing requirement at scale.

- Cross-Tenant Access Settings (CTAS) design
- Guest/externally authenticated access patterns
- Conditional Access, device posture, sign-in risk integration
- Expiry, auto-revocation, audit, rollback

```yaml
# CTAS inbound/outbound example (conceptual)
inbound:
  tenants:
    - PartnerA
    - PartnerB
    - PartnerC
  access:
    - role: GuestViewer

        mfa: true
        devicePosture: compliant
        signInRisk: low
outbound:
  applications:
    - PowerBI
```

- How would you monitor and respond to rising partner tenant risk?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates your understanding of cross-tenant delegation, least-privilege access principles, and end-to-end governance controls.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Lighthouse managed service offers
- Scoped RBAC with granular resource guards
- Conditional Access policies (MFA, device posture compliance)
- Activity auditing via Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
- Time-bounded access with automatic expiration
- Rollback and cleanup procedures

## Code Example
```powershell
# Create Lighthouse offer with scoped access
az deployment mg create \
  --location eastus \
  --managed-by-tenant-id <partner-tenant-id> \
  --authorizations '{"principalId":"<principal-id>","roleDefinitionId":"<role-id>","principalIdDisplayName":"Partner Access"}'

# Assign with time-bound expiration
az role assignment create \
  --scope /subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/<rg-name> \
  --assignee-object-id <partner-object-id> \
  --roleDefinitionName "Reader" \
  --assignee-valid-from $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") \
  --assignee-valid-until $(date -u -d "+30 days" +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

# Cleanup on expiry
az role assignment delete --scope /subscriptions/<sub-id>/resourceGroups/<rg-name> --assignee-object-id <partner-object-id>
```

## Why This Is Asked

Evaluates practical understanding of PIM, JIT, approvals, MFA enforcement, break-glass controls, auditability, and safe production rollout practices.

## Key Concepts

- Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
- Just-In-Time (JIT) access
- Approval workflows and on-call groups
- Time-bound activation and break-glass procedures
- Auditing, alerts, and post-access reviews
- Sandbox validation before production

## Code Example

```yaml
# Example policy outline (conceptual)
name: PIM-Owner-JIT
policy:
  role: Owner
  scope: /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<prod-rg>
  maxActivationHours: 2
  approvals:
    - group: on-call-admins
  mfaRequired: true
  breakGlassAccount: true
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test revocation when the 2-hour window expires and a change is still in progress?
- What logging and alerting would you implement to detect misuse or credential leakage?
